task: Replicate official BukSU Secretary's Minutes Form (OVPAA-F-INS-032) to exactly match reference PDF across 3 pages with secretary digital signature sign-off, live ADM synchronization, and deterministic 3-page A4 print/PDF pagination

contextGathering.referenceForm: Form OVPAA-F-INS-032 (3-Page Capstone Prototype Defense Hearing Minutes)

implementationDetails.institutionalFormReplication: Implemented 1:1 authentic replication of Form OVPAA-F-INS-032 across 3 exact pages matching typography, headers, BukSU official seal, proponents list, defense round badges, and panel critique table.
implementationDetails.digitalSignature: Embedded interactive SignaturePad supporting drawn strokes and typed cursive legal signatures, saving directly to project secretary minutes and unlocking committee signatures.
implementationDetails.admSynchronization: Bi-directional live synchronization between Secretary's Minutes and Action Done Matrix (ADM). Signing minutes automatically endorses secretary tier in ADM (`project.admSignatures.secretary.endorsed = true`).
implementationDetails.printPagination: Isolated all non-printable UI chrome via `.no-print` and enforced compact print typography (9.5pt font, tight cell padding, page-break-after: always on pages 1-2, break-after: auto on page 3) generating exactly 3 A4 pages with zero orphan lines.
